name: textarea
description: Multiline native input with the same validation and focus treatment as Input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the part and everything inside it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Use the destructive border and focus ring; provide an accessible error explanation.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description:
An accessibility hint helps users understand what will happen when they perform
an action on the accessibility element when that result is not obvious from the
accessibility label.


See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#accessibilityHint

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description:
Overrides the text that's read by the screen reader when the user interacts
with the element. By default, the label is constructed by traversing all
the children and accumulating all the `Text` nodes separated by space.

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#accessibilitylabel

props.name: accessibilityState
props.description: Indicates to accessibility services that UI Component is in a specific State.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Provides an initial value that will change when the user starts typing.
Useful for simple use-cases where you do not want to deal with listening
to events and updating the value prop to keep the controlled state in sync.

props.name: editable
props.description: If `false`, text is not editable. The default value is `true`.

props.name: hitSlop
props.description:
This defines how far a touch event can start away from the view.
Typical interface guidelines recommend touch targets that are at least
30 - 40 points/density-independent pixels.

> The touch area never extends past the parent view bounds and the Z-index
> of sibling views always takes precedence if a touch hits two overlapping
> views.

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#hitslop

props.name: keyboardType
props.description:
Determines which keyboard to open, e.g.`numeric`.

The following values work across platforms:

- `default`
- `numeric`
- `number-pad`
- `decimal-pad`
- `email-address`
- `phone-pad`
- `url`

*iOS Only*

The following values work on iOS only:

- `ascii-capable`
- `numbers-and-punctuation`
- `name-phone-pad`
- `twitter`
- `web-search`

*Android Only*

The following values work on Android only:

- `visible-password`

props.name: multiline
props.description:
If `true`, the text input can be multiple lines.
The default value is `false`.

props.name: numberOfLines
props.description:
Sets the number of lines for a `TextInput`. Use it with multiline set to
`true` to be able to fill the lines.

props.name: onBlur
props.type: ((e: Readonly<{ bubbles: boolean | undefined; cancelable: boolean | undefined; currentTarget: number | ReactNativeElement; defaultPrevented: boolean | undefi…
props.description: Callback that is called when the text input is blurred.

props.name: onChangeText
props.description:
Callback that is called when the text input's text changes.
Changed text is passed as an argument to the callback handler.

props.name: onFocus
props.type: ((e: Readonly<{ bubbles: boolean | undefined; cancelable: boolean | undefined; currentTarget: number | ReactNativeElement; defaultPrevented: boolean | undefi…
props.description: Callback that is called when the text input is focused.

props.name: onPress
props.type: ((event: Readonly<Omit<Readonly<{ bubbles: boolean | undefined; cancelable: boolean | undefined; currentTarget: number | ReactNativeElement; defaultPrevented…
props.description: Called when a single tap gesture is detected.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The string that will be rendered before text input has been entered.

props.name: secureTextEntry
props.description:
If `true`, the text input obscures the text entered so that sensitive text
like passwords stay secure. The default value is `false`. Does not work with 'multiline={true}'.

props.name: style
props.description:
Note that not all Text styles are supported, an incomplete list of what is not supported includes:

- `borderLeftWidth`
- `borderTopWidth`
- `borderRightWidth`
- `borderBottomWidth`
- `borderTopLeftRadius`
- `borderTopRightRadius`
- `borderBottomRightRadius`
- `borderBottomLeftRadius`

see [Issue#7070](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/7070)
for more detail.

[Styles](docs/style.html)

props.name: testID
props.description:
Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.

> This disables the 'layout-only view removal' optimization for this view!

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#testid

props.name: value
props.description:
The value to show for the text input. `TextInput` is a controlled
component, which means the native value will be forced to match this
value prop if provided. For most uses, this works great, but in some
cases this may cause flickering - one common cause is preventing edits
by keeping value the same. In addition to simply setting the same value,
either set `editable={false}`, or set/update `maxLength` to prevent
unwanted edits without flicker.
